name: Peire Rogièr de Cabal
source:
The general of Béziers' army in Lisette Vertorre's If Story. Despite his old age, he is still an excellent warrior and tactician who managed to defend Béziers until the 10,000 crusaders came to put an end to the city. 

[From the [url=http://11eyes.wikia.com/wiki/Main_Page]11eyes wiki[/url].]
